section.p: Consider a "Rotate API Access Keys" chapter in a "Security Operations Guide" document where you want to provide mandatory follow-up actions that users must complete after rotating production API keys.
section.codeblock:
Rotate production API access keys without interrupting client integrations.

Ensure that you have administrator access to the API gateway and a backup copy of the existing credentials.

Generate a new API access key from the API Gateway console.

A new active API key is generated for the selected application.

Update client applications with the newly generated API key.

Client applications authenticate successfully using the new credentials.

Disable the previous API access key.

The old API key is revoked and can no longer be used for authentication.

All client integrations now authenticate using the rotated API credentials.

  1. Monitor authentication logs for failed login attempts during the next 24 hours.
  2. Notify integration owners that the old API credentials are no longer valid.
section.p: Result: Use the <postreq> element for required follow-up activities, cleanup tasks, monitoring instructions, or operational checks that users must complete after the main procedure finishes.
